battle.name: 白藤江之戰
battle.brief: 白藤江之戰是交州靜海軍對南漢遠征水軍的決戰。938年冬，節度使吳權在白藤江沉入削尖木楔，以輕舟佯敗誘南漢大船入伏，待退潮船隻擱淺，弓弩齊發、步卒登船，斬南漢平海將軍弘操，敵軍死傷逾半。此役無重裝步卒正面對撞，卡面希臘重步兵並未在場，方陣互相遮蔽的邏輯只在交趾水軍接舷時隱約重現。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 白藤江之戰是十世紀末交州（交趾）與南漢之間的一場水陸大戰，交戰雙方在名義上都還掛著中原王朝的招牌，實際上已是兩個各自獨立的政治力量。交州一方是靜海軍節度使吳權的軍隊：靜海軍是唐末以來交州鎮系將校世襲的部曲，節度使衙署設在交州城（今海陽郡水原一帶），兵源以交州鄉兵與俚人部曲為主，另有自嶺南、兩廣流散而來的客籍將校，編制仍循唐代藩鎮「牙兵親兵—州縣鄉兵」的兩層結構，上層是與將校有姻親、故舊關係的核心部曲，下層是臨時徵發的鄉兵與水手。吳權出身蒲陽，父吳公智在交州領兵，他以誅殺自立節度使麴公粲、平定內亂取得位置，水寨、舟師與糧秣都握在自己手裡。南漢一方是劉氏政權直轄的中央水軍：劉龔坐鎮廣州，遣第九子弘操以平海將軍、交趾王號率師南征，兵員自嶺南各州抽調，配海船、大舶與隨軍糧秣，後方留有京畿宿衞與閩、楚兩方向的策應之師。兩軍最終在白藤江一段狹窄水道遭遇：交州方以水寨、舟隊與江灘堡壘構成抵抗，吳權的部署目標很明確，先挫其舟，再挫其將，把南漢精銳封死在灘上。
countriesEn: The Battle of Bạch Đằng was a land-and-water war fought in the late tenth century between Giao Châu (Jiaozhi, Đại Nam) and the Southern Han, both of which still bore the formal titles of the central Chinese dynasties while in practice having become separate political powers. The Giao Châu side was the army of Ngô Quyền, military governor of the Tĩnh Hải Army. The Tĩnh Hải Army was a hereditary service corps of circuit officer families that had formed in Giao Châu since the late Tang; its governor's headquarters sat in the city of Giao Châu (in the area of Thủy Nguyên in modern Hải Phòng), and its strength came mainly from local Giao Châu levies and Bạch Việt tribal war-bands, together with officer families who had drifted in from Lĩnh Nam and the Two Guangs. Its organisation still followed the Tang circuit pattern of two layers, a core of tooth soldiers and close retainers bound to the commanders by marriage and old loyalty, and below them the levies and boatmen raised on the spot from the prefectures and counties. Ngô Quyền was a native of Phú Dương; his father Ngô Công Trí had served as a commander in Giao Châu, and he himself gained his position by putting down the self-styled circuit governor Kiều Công Tiễn and settling the internal disorder, keeping the river stockades, the fleet and the supplies in his own hands. The Southern Han side was a central fleet directly commanded by the Liu house: Lưu Cung sat at Guangzhou and sent his ninth son Hoằng Tháo south with the titles General of Pacifying the Sea and Prince of Giao Chỉ, drawing his men from the prefectures of Lĩnh Nam, equipping them with sea-going ships, large transports and their own baggage train, and keeping the capital guard and the relief armies of the Min and Chu directions in the rear. The two forces finally met in a narrow reach of the Bạch Đằng: the Giao Châu side built its resistance out of river stockades, war-craft and shore forts, and Ngô Quyền's stated aim was blunt enough, break their ships first and then break their general, sealing the Southern Han elite up on the mud flats.
people: 吳權是此戰唯一的主角，越南史家稱其為「興國大王」與「聖宗」，視為民族復國的關鍵人物。他早年以交州將校之子在父吳公智帳下效力，累升至鎮將，目睹交州在楊定業（又記楊平）時期一度脫離南漢，後楊定業被自己部將麴公粲所殺，麴公粲挾勢向廣州請援，吳權以「清君側」的名義起兵，先破麴公粲於大羅（地望在今海陽省海陽市一帶，諸說略有出入），隨後被迫面對南漢兩萬大軍自海路逼近。策劃此役的關鍵人物是吳權的參軍吳昌熾，越史記載由他獻策伐竹削楔、預置江底，並請吳權「候潮而發」，等南漢大船駛入楔區、退潮擱淺之後再全軍殺出。吳權本身的選擇也很關鍵：他沒有死守交州城，也沒有在陸地上跟南漢硬碰，而是把主力縮在白藤江水道，用潮汐與木楔換取兵力。南漢方面，統軍的弘操是劉龔第九子，被封平海將軍、交趾王，領兵經海路入交州；他在越史中被描寫為驕於水戰、輕視越軍輕舟，一入江口便直追不捨，最終死於亂軍之中，屍骸與殘兵同墜江中。南漢王劉龔本人並未到前線，只在後方接應處聞訊而退，後來自歎失去兩個兒子的名字不祥。
peopleEn: Ngô Quyền is the single central figure of the campaign; Vietnamese historians call him the Great King who founded the state and the Sagacious Emperor, and treat him as the decisive personality of the national recovery. The son of a Giao Châu officer, he served under his father Ngô Công Trí and rose to the rank of town commander, and he watched Giao Châu break away from the Southern Han under Dương Đình Nghệ, also recorded as Dương Bình. When that governor was killed by his own commander Kiều Công Tiễn, and Kiều Công Tiễn turned to Guangzhou for help, Ngô Quyền rose under the banner of clearing the court of a villain, destroyed Kiều Công Tiễn at Đại La, a place variously located in the modern province of Hải Dương, and was then confronted with a Southern Han army of twenty thousand coming up by sea. The planner of the campaign was his staff officer Ngô Xương Ngập, who according to the Vietnamese historical texts proposed cutting bamboo into sharpened wedges, sinking them on the riverbed in advance, and urging his chief to wait for the tide and strike only once the great Southern Han ships had entered the wedge zone and run aground on the ebb. Ngô Quyền's own decisions matter as much: he did not shut himself up in the city of Giao Châu, nor try to meet the Southern Han head-on across dry land, but concentrated his main force inside the Bạch Đằng watercourse, buying strength with tide and timber instead of men. On the Southern Han side the commander in the field was Hoằng Tháo, the ninth son of Lưu Cung, appointed General of Pacifying the Sea and Prince of Giao Chỉ, who led the fleet into Giao Châu by sea. The Vietnamese records paint him as overconfident in his water fighting and contemptuous of the light craft of the Giao Châu army; he chased straight into the river mouth without pause and died amid the broken ranks, his body and the remnants of his troops going down into the river together. Lưu Cung himself never came forward, broke off at the staging point in the rear after the news reached him, and afterwards lamented that the names of his two sons had proved ill-omened.
kits: 白藤江戰場上沒有希臘重步兵。卡面這件兵器在此戰的位置，是作為「重裝步卒正面對撞」這一類戰法的對照物：希臘方陣以大圓盾相接、前排吃住第一波衝撞，後排壓住前排的背後，重點是讓個人力量讓位給互相遮蔽的整體。938年交州與南漢之間發生的是完全不同的一件事，交戰主體是舟師與水陸接舷步卒，交趾方面真正上手的裝備有：削尖的竹楔與木楔（配鐵釘，埋入江底泥沙，僅露出少許尖端）、藤盾與木盾、短刀與長柄刀、長矛與鉤槍（用來鉤住敵船船舷、扯斷纜索）、弓與弩（弓兵列陣齊射，是壓制敵船甲板人數的主要手段）、皮甲與少量鐵甲（南漢水軍多為南人，披甲比例低但船舷有木製擋板，箭矢難穿）、輕舟與走舸（吃水淺、轉向快，專做誘敵與切斷退路）、大舶與樓船（南漢主力，海上遠航所備，寬而平，吃水深，一旦擱淺便難以脫身）、以及水寨用的木柵、長矛陣與漁網障。糧秣方面，交州就地取食，稻米、魚乾與鹽為主，冬季枯水期正是船隻吃水變淺、木楔容易下插的時節；南漢遠征則要靠海路後勤，糧水船隊一旦在下游被截斷，前線便難以續戰。
kitsEn: There were no Greek hoplites on the Bạch Đằng battlefield. The weapon on the card stands here as a contrast to a style of fighting built around the frontal collision of heavily armoured infantry: the Greek phalanx closed round shields side by side so that the front rank absorbed the first impact, with the rear ranks pressing on the backs of those in front, its whole point being to subordinate individual strength to a mutually sheltering whole. What actually fought in Giao Châu in 938 was something entirely different, the combat being carried mainly by fleets and by boarding parties that fought from the decks. The equipment in the Giao Châu hands was: sharpened bamboo and wooden wedges fitted with iron nails and driven into the mud of the riverbed so that only the points showed above the silt; rattan and wooden shields; short swords and long-handled sabres; long spears and hooked polearms used to hook enemy gunwales and cut mooring lines; bows and crossbows, the archers firing in formed volleys, the main means of killing men on the decks; leather armour and a little iron plate, the Southern Han crews being southerners who rarely wore mail but whose ships had timber bulwarks that stopped arrows; light craft and fast rowing boats, shallow-draught and quick to turn, used for feigned flight and for cutting off the retreat; and finally the great transports and tower ships of the Southern Han, broad and flat-bottomed, deep-draught, and hopeless once they were aground. On the materiel side the Giao Châu army lived off the country, with rice, dried fish and salt, and the winter dry season was exactly the time when ships drew least water and the wedges could be planted most easily; the Southern Han expedition, by contrast, depended on sea-borne supply, and once its grain and water flotilla was cut off downstream the front line could not be sustained.
tactics: 交州方面的戰法由吳昌熾策劃、吳權拍板，核心是把地形與潮汐當成可以計算的兵器。步驟大致是：先在白藤江下游一段河道選點，此處江面收窄、水流較緩，退潮時大片灘塗與沙洲出露，正是上游大船吃水淺、轉向慢的段落；隨後在夜裡或大潮掩護之下，用漁船把削尖木楔一批批運到江心，逐段落楔入泥中，再以水草、浮木與淤泥覆蓋，使水面看來如常；接著以輕舟小艇在江面挑釁，作出不支之狀往上游退，把南漢大船引入楔區；待潮水退盡，大船逐一擱淺，舷側被木楔刺穿、龍骨卡在灘上，無法偏轉；這時交州弓弩手沿兩岸與船隊之間的狹水道齊射，掩護接舷步卒搭板登上敵船近身格鬥，輕舟同時切斷敵隊首尾聯繫，使被擱淺的先頭船隻得不到後隊支援。南漢方面的失誤則相當典型：船型龐大、吃水深，本不適合在內河淺水水道行軍，卻因輕敵而一路追擊到底，沒有在第一時間下碇查探，潮汐轉向也未預留退路；一旦楔區顯形，龐大艦隊在退潮中集體受困，前排沉滯、後排擁塞，縱有弓弩反擊亦無處展開。整場戰鬥的勝負窗口極窄：楔若提早露出，敵船避開即失效；退潮太遲，敵船安然通過即失效，故必須精確掌握潮時，史料稱交州軍「候潮而發」，並選在冬季枯水、月晦前後潮差較大的日子動手。
tacticsEn: The Giao Châu plan was drawn up by Ngô Xương Ngập and approved by Ngô Quyền; its core was to treat terrain and tide as weapons that could be calculated. The stages ran roughly as follows. First a point was chosen in a lower reach of the Bạch Đằng where the channel narrowed and the current slackened, and where the falling tide laid bare broad mud flats and sandbanks, a stretch on which the big upstream ships drew little water and turned slowly. Then, at night or under cover of a spring tide, fishing boats carried sharpened wedges out to midstream in batches, drove them into the mud bundle by bundle, and covered them with water plants, driftwood and silt so that the surface still looked like open water. Next light craft and skiffs were sent out into the channel to provoke, and then feigned collapse, withdrawing upstream as though unable to stand, drawing the Southern Han ships into the wedge zone. When the tide ran out the great ships grounded one after another, their sides pierced by the wedges and their keels locked into the flats, unable to turn. At that moment the Giao Châu archers and crossbowmen fired in volleys from both banks and from the narrow channels between the hulls, covering the boarding parties as they laid planks across and fought hand to hand, while light boats cut the enemy's line of communication so that the stranded leading ships could not be helped by the rear. The Southern Han errors were typical. Their ship types were huge and deep-draught and had no business in a shallow inland watercourse, yet they had pressed on in contempt of the enemy, never anchoring to reconnoitre, and had left no way back when the tide turned. Once the wedge zone showed itself the great flotilla was caught together on the ebb, the leading ships fouled and the rear pressed down behind them, and even their crossbowmen had no room to deploy. The window in which the whole thing could work was extremely narrow: if the wedges showed too early the enemy would sheer off and the plan would be worthless; if the ebb came too late the enemy would pass through untouched and the wedges would be equally worthless. Precise control of the tide hour was therefore essential, the texts saying that the Giao Châu army struck in obedience to the tide, and that the action was launched in the winter dry season around the dark of the moon, when the range of the tide was widest.
data: 可核對的數字主要來自越南史籍。兵員：南漢方面，越南史家記弘操率兵二萬（《大越史記全書》系於南漢遣子弘操將兵二萬），此數常被後世引為本戰南漢大軍之眾；交州方面人數史無確載，一般只說吳權「選勇卒」、集結愛州方向的部曲與鄉兵，遠少於南漢，故必須以計謀取勝。傷亡：越史記載南漢軍死者過半，弘操與大部將士隨敗軍沉江，殘兵退回海路；南漢王在後方聞訊，收攏餘眾而退。時間：938年歲末冬季，越史多繫於十二月，說是「終冬」之戰。地理與水文：白藤江為清江（太平江）下游支流，今北寧省白藤縣境內，注入北部灣；三處白藤江之戰（938、981、1288）同在這一段水道。武器消耗：越軍預先沉入的竹木楔數以千計，越史記其「如林」；弩箭與弓矢在一天之內大量消耗，箭鏃多為鐵質，回收難，故戰後雙方都缺箭。物資：交州當地糧秣充足，冬季漁獲減少但稻米與鹽有存；南漢遠征靠海船運糧，一旦退路被截，糧水最先斷。人口與城：交州城（今海陽郡水原）為節度使衙署所在，吳權在戰前已加固城防與水寨。
dataEn: The figures that can be checked come mainly from the Vietnamese historical texts. Troop strength: on the Southern Han side, the Vietnamese historians record that Hoằng Tháo led twenty thousand men, the Đại Việt sử ký toàn thư stating that the Southern Han sent the prince Hoằng Tháo with two myriad soldiers, and this number is the one usually cited in later literature for the size of the Southern Han army. For the Giao Châu side no reliable count survives; the texts only say that Ngô Quyền picked his best fighters and drew on the war-bands and levies coming up from the Ái Châu direction, plainly far fewer than the enemy, which is why the battle had to be won by calculation. Losses: the Vietnamese records state that more than half of the Southern Han army fell, that Hoằng Tháo and most of his officers went down with the broken fleet, and that the survivors made their way back by sea; the Southern Han king, hearing the news at his staging point, gathered the remnants and withdrew. Date: the end of winter in the year 938, which the Vietnamese chronicles generally attach to the twelfth month, calling it a battle fought in the last of the winter. Geography and hydrology: the Bạch Đằng is a distributary of the lower Thanh (Thái Bình) river system, running through what is now Bạch Đằng district in Bắc Ninh province and emptying into the Gulf of Tonkin; the three battles of the Bạch Đằng, in 938, 981 and 1288, were all fought on this reach. Consumption of materiel: the bamboo and wooden wedges sunk by the Giao Châu army ran to thousands, the texts describing them as standing like a forest; bows and crossbows consumed enormous quantities of arrows in the course of a single day, the heads mostly of iron and hard to recover, so both sides were short of ammunition afterwards. Supply: the Giao Châu provinces were rich in provisions, with the winter fishing catch down but rice and salt in store; the Southern Han expedition drew its food by sea, and once the line of retreat was cut it was food and water that failed first. Men and towns: the city of Giao Châu, in modern Thủy Nguyên in Hải Phòng, was the seat of the circuit governor's office, and Ngô Quyền had already strengthened its walls and the river stockades before the battle.
cause: 白藤江之戰的起因分三層。最內一層是交州內部的權力危機：節度使楊定業（又記楊平）被自己部將麴公粲所殺，麴公粲挾兵自重，並不打算真正服從南漢，而是利用南漢的援兵保住自己的位置；南漢則正好藉此重新伸手交州。吳權起兵誅麴公粲，等於替南漢清除了名義上的障礙，也讓自己站到與南漢直接對面的位置。第二層是南漢的戰略需要：交州一地扼住紅河三角洲的米、鹽與象牙通道，自九三一年楊定業逐走南漢兵之後，交州實際自治，歲貢斷絕，海路商貨改由海商繞道；對劉龔而言，容忍交州自立，等於容忍一道關口長期外開，因此必須出兵把交州收復。派弘操而非大將領兵、封「交趾王」，是為了給南漢留一面「事平之後仍以土人治交州」的台階。第三層是交州方面的自保邏輯：吳權清楚南漢必來，且兵力遠勝，於是不求速戰，只求把戰場設在對方最不擅長的地方——內河、潮汐與灘塗。他寧可讓大軍退守水寨、拖到冬季，也不願在城郊的陸地上被南漢的步騎包圍。
causeEn: The origins of the battle of Bạch Đằng lie in three layers. The innermost is a crisis of authority inside Giao Châu: the circuit governor Dương Đình Nghệ, also recorded as Dương Bình, was killed by his own commander Kiều Công Tiễn, who then held the troops in his own grip and had no intention of truly serving the Southern Han, only of using their reinforcements to keep his own seat; the Southern Han, for its part, took the opportunity offered to reach for Giao Châu again. Ngô Quyền's rising against Kiều Công Tiễn thus removed the nominal obstacle for the Southern Han and simultaneously put himself directly in the path of the Southern Han army. The second layer is strategic necessity on the Southern Han side. Giao Châu controls the rice, salt and ivory routes of the Red River delta, and since Dương Đình Nghệ drove out the Southern Han garrisons in 931 the province had in practice run itself, the annual tribute had stopped, and the coastal trade had been diverted to private shipping. For Lưu Cung, tolerating an autonomous Giao Châu meant tolerating a gate in the frontier that stood permanently ajar, and the province had to be recovered. Sending Hoằng Tháo rather than a senior general, and conferring the title Prince of Giao Chỉ, was meant to leave the Southern Han a face-saving formula under which local men would still govern the province once things were settled. The third layer is the logic of Giao Châu's own defence. Ngô Quyền knew perfectly well that the Southern Han would come and that they would bring more men, so he did not seek a quick decision; he sought to place the fighting on the ground where the enemy was least at home, the inland water, the tide and the mud flats. He would rather pull the army back into the stockades and hold until winter than be enveloped on dry land outside the city by the Southern Han cavalry and infantry.
impact: 白藤江之戰的後果，遠遠超出一次戰役本身的勝負。南漢放棄了收復交州的打算，越史直說自此不敢再窺交州；交州由此獲得一段實質獨立的時期，越南史家通常以938年為北屬時期終結的標誌，吳權次年稱王建吳朝，定都古螺，開啟了後來前黎、李、陳等朝相繼獨立的局面。這一勝同時改變了區域權力結構：南漢把重心轉回嶺北與中原爭雄，交州則以交趾王的名號自居，兩者的藩屬關係從此長期處於若即若離的狀態。軍事層面的影響更為長久，「候潮而發、預置木楔」的水戰法門自938年起成為交州軍的招牌，同一條白藤江在981年再度成為宋軍失利的戰場，1288年陳興道更以同一手法大破元軍，三戰三中，四百年後仍在複製同一套邏輯。吳權在戰後數年內經營海防、興造水寨、疏浚河道、鼓勵農耕、鑄造大平興寶式的銅錢，為後世吳朝與李朝的海洋國家形態打下基礎。
impactEn: The consequences of the battle of Bạch Đằng reached far beyond the fate of one engagement. The Southern Han abandoned the intention of recovering Giao Châu, the Vietnamese records saying plainly that from that point they dared not look at the province again. Giao Châu gained a period of genuine independence, and Vietnamese historians normally take the year 938 as the mark of the end of the northern domination; in the following year Ngô Quyền proclaimed himself king and founded the Ngô state with its capital at Cổ Loa, opening the succession of independent Vietnamese dynasties that would follow, the early Lê, the Trần and after them. The victory also rearranged the regional balance of power: the Southern Han turned its weight back north to contest the Central Plains, while Giao Châu sat on its own princely title and its relations with the north settled into a long state of formal submission and real independence. At the military level the effect was longer lived still. The method of waiting on the tide and planting wedges in advance became the signature of the Giao Châu army: the same Bạch Đằng was the place where a Song army was beaten in 981, and where Trần Hưng Đạo destroyed a Yuan fleet in 1288 by the same means, three battles and three successes reproducing one identical logic four centuries later. In the years after the victory Ngô Quyền built up the sea defences, raised river stockades, dredged channels, promoted farming and struck copper coin in the Taiping Xingbao pattern, laying the groundwork for the maritime shape of the Ngô state and of the Lê state after it.
result: 南漢的遠征軍在白藤江被徹底擊潰。弘操率大船深入楔區，潮退之後全線擱淺，弓弩齊射之下死傷過半，弘操本人陣亡，屍身隨殘兵墜江；前鋒與後隊被輕舟切斷，首尾不能相救，餘部由海路退回廣州。交州方面損失有限，吳權的水寨、舟隊與城防基本完好，吳昌熾所獻的「候潮而發」之策完全奏效，吳權威望由此奠定。直接的政治結果，是南漢在放棄以武力收復交州的同時，承認既成事實，兩國往來重新以使節與貿易維持，而交州在實質上脫離了南漢的軍令系統。次年，即九三九年，吳權稱王，改元建元年（年號說法不一），建吳朝，定都古螺，此後由吳朝而前黎朝，開啟越南自主王朝相繼的序列。白藤江亦由一條普通水道，一躍而成越南歷史上的象徵性地名，直至今日仍是當地最著名的古戰場之一。
resultEn: The Southern Han expeditionary force was completely broken on the Bạch Đằng. Hoằng Tháo had run his great ships deep into the wedge zone, and once the tide fell the whole line was aground; under the volleys of bows and crossbows more than half the men fell, Hoằng Tháo himself was killed, and his body went down into the river with the broken troops. Light craft had cut the fleet into isolated sections so that the leading ships could not be rescued by those behind, and the survivors made their way back to Guangzhou by sea. The Giao Châu side lost comparatively little: Ngô Quyền's stockades, fleet and city works came through the day essentially intact, and the plan of Ngô Xương Ngập, to strike in obedience to the tide, worked exactly as designed, fixing Ngô Quyền's prestige in the process. The immediate political result was that the Southern Han, in giving up the attempt to retake Giao Châu by force, accepted the accomplished fact; intercourse between the two was resumed through envoys and trade, while Giao Châu in substance left the Southern Han's military command system behind. In the following year, 939, Ngô Quyền proclaimed himself king, founded the Ngô state and made Cổ Loa his capital, beginning the sequence of Vietnamese dynasties that ran from the Ngô through the early Lê. The Bạch Đằng itself, from an ordinary watercourse, became in a single stroke the most symbolic place name in Vietnamese history and remains one of the most famous battlefields in the country to this day.
